notes:
=== CONCEPT ===
--script <category> runs every script in a named NSE category. Key categories: default (safe enumeration), vuln (CVE checks, heavy service interaction), auth (credential testing), brute (password brute force), discovery (network/service discovery).

=== VULN CATEGORY ===
vuln scripts cross-reference service versions against CVE databases. Against WordPress: identifies admin paths, discovers valid usernames (http-wordpress-users), lists CVEs with CVSS scores and links. Direct bridge from enumeration to exploitation planning.

=== CAUTION ===
dos, exploit, intrusive categories can disrupt/harm services — use only with explicit authorization. vuln sits in the middle — no exploitation, but heavy interaction that may trigger IDS alerts.

=== SYNTAX ===
--script vuln runs all vuln scripts. --script 'vuln and safe' runs only vuln scripts also tagged safe. --script 'not intrusive' excludes intrusive ones.
